summary: Legacy build agent failing intermittently, blocking release pipelines
description: Intermittent failures observed on the legacy CI build agent pool (agent-legacy-1..3). Failures occur during docker image pulls and workspace setup, causing release pipeline jobs to fail or stall and occasionally blocking release gating.
steps_to_reproduce: Trigger release-ci workflow on release/* branch
Observe job 'build-and-package' waiting on container image pull
Job errors with 'error pulling image: unexpected EOF' or system shows 'no space left on device' on the agent node
logs_excerpt:
[2026-03-02T15:12:07Z] pulling image quay.io/redwood/runner:legacy-2025-09 failed: unexpected EOF
[2026-03-02T15:12:20Z] cleanup: docker container setup failed: write /var/lib/docker: no space left on device
investigation_notes: Reproduced on agent-legacy-2 with disk pressure and many dangling images
Manual docker prune reduced usage and allowed subsequent jobs to succeed
Automated cleanup cron job appears disabled on the legacy pool
Suspect long-term growth due to old rollout artifacts and missing image GC
workarounds: Manually pruned images and restarted agent service to recover jobs
Reroute critical release jobs to ci-modern pool as temporary mitigation
next_steps: Schedule maintenance window to decommission legacy pool and migrate jobs to ci-modern
Add monitoring alert for disk usage on agent nodes (threshold 75%)
Implement automated nightly prune job and document process in Confluence
